stories.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum
stories.summary: Charles Schwab has widened its crypto trading offering beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum, according to Decrypt. The report does not specify which additional tokens are now available or when access begins.
stories.whyItMatters: A major retail brokerage broadening crypto access points to deeper mainstream integration of digital assets.
whatToWatch: Which tokens Schwab adds to the platform
Client demand and trading volume for the new assets
questions: Which specific cryptocurrencies are being added?
Are there limits, fees, or custody differences versus BTC and ETH?

stories.title: Ethereum ETFs Pull In $226M in a Day, Nearly Matching Bitcoin ETF Inflows
stories.summary: US spot Ethereum ETFs took in $226 million in a single day, coming close to matching Bitcoin ETF inflows over the same period, Decrypt reports. The figures point to strengthening institutional demand for ETH exposure through regulated funds.
stories.whyItMatters: Ethereum ETF flows nearing Bitcoin's suggest institutional interest is broadening beyond BTC as the primary crypto entry point.
whatToWatch: Whether daily ETH ETF inflows keep pace with Bitcoin's in coming reports
Total cumulative ETH ETF assets versus Bitcoin ETFs
questions: What is driving the sudden jump in ETH ETF demand?
Will the inflow pace hold or was this a one-day spike?

sources.title: Ethereum ETFs Take $226M in a Day, Almost Matching Bitcoin's Haul

stories.title: Bullish Gives USD.AI a $100M Stablecoin Facility for GPU-Backed Lending
stories.summary: Crypto exchange Bullish has provided a $100 million stablecoin credit facility to USD.AI, which the company will use for GPU-backed lending, Cointelegraph reports. The deal links stablecoin liquidity to financing for AI computing hardware.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows stablecoins moving beyond trading into real-world lending, and crypto capital flowing into AI infrastructure financing.
whatToWatch: How USD.AI deploys the facility and to which borrowers
Repayment performance and any signs of stress in GPU-backed loans
questions: What collateral and terms govern the GPU-backed loans?
What oversight, if any, applies to this lending activity?

stories.title: Polish Olympic Committee Chief Charged in Zondacrypto Probe
stories.summary: Poland's Olympic committee chief has been charged as part of an investigation tied to crypto exchange Zondacrypto, the country's justice minister said, according to Cointelegraph. Further details of the charges were not given.
stories.whyItMatters: A criminal probe touching a major national sports figure and a crypto exchange raises questions about oversight and trust in the platform.
whatToWatch: Formal charging documents and specific allegations
Any response or statement from Zondacrypto
questions: What exactly is the Olympic chief accused of doing?
Is Zondacrypto itself a target of the investigation, or only linked through this individual?

stories.title: Chelsea FC Signs Stablecoin Sponsor Despite UK FCA Warning to Clubs
stories.summary: Chelsea FC has secured a stablecoin company as a sponsor, a move that comes after the UK Financial Conduct Authority warned football clubs about crypto sponsorship deals, Cointelegraph reports. The report does not name the sponsor or detail the FCA's specific concerns.
stories.whyItMatters: It highlights friction between crypto firms' appetite for mainstream sports marketing and UK regulators' caution about consumer exposure to crypto products.
whatToWatch: Any FCA response to the Chelsea deal specifically
Whether other Premier League clubs pursue similar sponsorships
questions: Which stablecoin issuer is the sponsor?
What did the FCA's warning to clubs actually say?

stories.title: BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF Regains Weekly Options as Fund Captures Nearly All Daily Inflows
stories.summary: BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) has regained access to key weekly options expiries following a rule overhaul, CryptoSlate reports. Separately, the same fund captured 115% of all net Bitcoin ETF inflows on a single day, meaning rival Bitcoin ETFs saw net outflows over that period.
stories.whyItMatters: Renewed options access affects hedging and liquidity around IBIT, while the inflow dominance shows the Bitcoin ETF market consolidating around BlackRock's fund.
whatToWatch: Options market activity around the newly available weekly expiries
Whether flow concentration into BlackRock's fund continues or reverses
questions: What prompted the rule overhaul that restored the weekly expiries?
Why are rival Bitcoin ETFs losing assets while IBIT gains?

sources.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF regains key weekly options expiries after rule overhaul
BlackRock just pulled in 115% of all Bitcoin ETF inflows in a single day as rival funds bleed cash

stories.title: Bitcoin Miner IREN Shares Fall as AI Conversion Costs Mount
stories.summary: Shares of Bitcoin miner IREN dropped as the costs of converting parts of its operations toward AI computing increased, Decrypt reports. The report does not break out specific cost figures.
stories.whyItMatters: IREN's stumble illustrates the financial strain miners face as they pivot capacity from Bitcoin mining toward AI data centers.
whatToWatch: IREN's next financial disclosures on conversion costs
Whether other Bitcoin miners pursuing AI pivots show similar cost pressure
questions: How large are the AI conversion costs relative to IREN's mining revenue?
Is the core Bitcoin mining business still profitable during the transition?

stories.title: Bitcoin Dips to $78.4K as Fed's Warsh Downplays Softer Inflation Data
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to $78,400 after Federal Reserve official Kevin Warsh downplayed recent softer inflation readings, Cointelegraph reports. The comments tempered expectations for near-term rate cuts, weighing on crypto prices.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows how directly Bitcoin's price still tracks shifting Fed rate-cut expectations rather than trading independently.
whatToWatch: Further Fed commentary ahead of the next policy meeting
Whether Bitcoin stabilizes or falls further from $78.4K
questions: Will the Fed's stance on rate cuts shift in coming weeks?
How long will crypto prices stay this sensitive to Fed rhetoric?

stories.title: JPMorgan-Linked IBIT Bitcoin ETF Bet Misses Window to Avoid 6% Deduction
stories.summary: A JPMorgan-linked structured bet tied to BlackRock's IBIT Bitcoin ETF missed a window that would have let it avoid a 6% deduction, CryptoSlate reports. The report does not detail the structure's full terms or who ultimately absorbs the cost.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a reminder that bank-structured crypto ETF products can carry hidden fee mechanics that erode investor returns.
whatToWatch: Confirmation of how the 6% deduction affects the product's payout
Any investor or bank response to the missed deadline
questions: What specifically triggers the 6% deduction?
Who bears the cost: JPMorgan, the fund, or end investors?

stories.title: ENA Jumps 10% as Ethena Puts Revenue-Funded Buybacks to a Vote
stories.summary: Ethena's ENA token rose 10% after the protocol put a proposal to fund token buybacks with protocol revenue up for a governance vote, Cointelegraph reports. The vote's outcome and timeline were not specified.
stories.whyItMatters: Revenue-funded buybacks are a growing DeFi mechanism for returning value to token holders, and this vote will test appetite for the model at Ethena's scale.
whatToWatch: The governance vote outcome and timeline
Buyback execution details if the proposal passes
questions: How much protocol revenue would be allocated to buybacks?
What voting threshold is needed for the proposal to pass?

stories.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Comments Trigger $488M Crypto Liquidation Cascade
stories.summary: Remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh raising rate-hike expectations triggered roughly $488 million in crypto liquidations, CryptoSlate reports. The wave of forced position closures followed his pushback on the idea that softer inflation data would prompt rate cuts.
stories.whyItMatters: The scale of liquidations shows how much leverage remains in crypto markets and how sharply it can react to Fed rhetoric.
whatToWatch: Further liquidation data if volatility continues
The Fed's next public remarks or policy meeting
questions: Were the liquidations concentrated in long or short positions?
Will volatility persist or fade once markets digest Warsh's comments?

sources.title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh triggers a $488 million crypto liquidation cascade as rate-hike expectations rise
